figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: SELECT TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,LOWER(category) AS clean_category,COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM raw_data GROUP BY TRIM(name),amount,LOWER(category) HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
